# `browser-tab plan`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab plan [FLAGS]`

Plan one tab transform without applying it (needs daemon)

## Flags

### `--selector <json>`

Selector AST as JSON; @<file> or - for stdin

### `--selection <id>`

A current select_tabs selectionId (instead of --selector)

### `--transform <json>`

Transform as JSON; @<file> or - for stdin

### `--end-state <json>`

Declarative end state (instead of selection+transform)

### `--pin-policy <p>`

Pinned members policy

**Choices:**

- `skip`
